examples.text: Одна маленькая формальность.
examples.trans: One small formality.

meanings.note: Declinable masculine noun meaning 'present', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Что это? Это маленький подарок тебе.
examples.trans: What is this? It is a little gift for you.

examples.text: Это тебе подарок.
examples.trans: This is a present for you.

examples.text: Спасибо за подарок!
examples.trans: Thank you for the present!
